title: External Data Accelerator: Your standards-first team and technology for conformant vendor data
summary: Our tech-enabled team embeds standards and validation from day one, so your data lands clean, and your study moves toward submission readiness.

### A cleaner path for external data from the start of your study, backed by the standards regulators trust.


More than 70% of study data now comes from external vendors, each with its own format and timeline. Certara pairs senior external data specialists with Pinnacle 21 Data Exchange so data lands clean, and your study moves towards submission readiness.


[Explore External Data Accelerator](https://www.certara.com/services/biometrics-data-sciences/external-data-accelerator/)
